raw_message.reasoning: So the CLI currently supports bump and compare only. We need new check subcommand, and expose public functions cmd_bump, cmd_check, cmd_compare. Also need to ensure that invoking pysemver without args raises SystemExit not AttributeError. Currently main uses parser.parse_args; if no args, parse_args will show help? Actually argparse by default will show error and exit. But maybe they want to raise SystemExit? parse_args raises SystemExit automatically when no args? Wait: if no args, parse_args will parse empty list; if no subcommand set, it will error "the following arguments are required: which". That raises SystemExit. But maybe they want to raise SystemExit instead of AttributeError due to bug. Let's run tests.
